title: JA4+ Runtime Reference & Structural Hunting Patterns for ARTEX and Agentic AI
operational_warning: DO NOT BLOCK ON STATIC JA4 OR JA4H HASHES ALONE. All static runtime fingerprints below belong to standard Go, OpenSSL, Python, and curl stacks shared by millions of benign services and drift across compiler/library releases. Use strictly for enrichment, stack classification, and correlation with UA mismatch, 4xx probing, or behavioral signals.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: Modern Chrome/Firefox/Edge 90+ User-Agent (excluding honest automation/WebView) paired with TLS<=1.2, missing ALPN (00), cipher count >=26, or extension count <=8.
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Skip TLS JA4 evaluation on traffic arriving from trusted L7 TLS-reoriginating reverse proxies.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: Modern Chrome/Firefox/Edge 90+ User-Agent paired with stripped CLI HTTP headers (<=5 headers and lang=0000; excluding OPTIONS op* and CONNECT co*).
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Survives L7 TLS-terminating reverse proxies; exclude health/metrics endpoints. Note: uses PCRE negative lookahead (valid in Python re / Splunk PCRE); for RE2/LogScale/Go engines, match ^[a-z]{2}[0-9]{2}[cn][rn]0[0-5]0000_ and exclude prefixes op/co separately.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: TLS ClientHello without SNI (4th character of JA4_a is 'i').
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Enrich with destination port, bytes_out, and non-asset error counts to exclude internal IP-based monitoring.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: Single source IP emits >=3 distinct JA4 or JA4H stacks against the same target with a single spoofed UA, >=3 non-asset 4xx errors, or >=2 edge auth failures (proxy-OFF mode).
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Require error/spoofed-UA corroboration to prevent false positives on corporate NAT gateways.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: Single source IP emits exactly 1 constant JA4 while rotating >=3 distinct client UA families (curl, python, browser, etc.) during non-asset 4xx/edge probing (ARTEX Go recording-proxy ON mode).
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Exclude corporate SWGs using browser-version grouping rather than raw UA strings.

structural_hunting_patterns.description: Self-signed certificate structure (ja4x_a == ja4x_b), excluding top public CAs, clustered by (ja4x_c, ja4s) on console/relay ports (8787, 8788, 8790, 8890, 8443).
structural_hunting_patterns.caveat: Pair with ASN/hosting-provider enrichment to separate dev lab boxes from active attacker infrastructure.
